title: airgap: vendored images and manifests for k3s/rke2 compatibility
author: Avery Cho
release_notes: Adds a focused airgap bundle and installer adjustments to support k3s and RKE2 clusters in on-prem/air-gapped environments. Includes vendored OCI image tarballs, distro-specific systemd overrides, Helm chart tweaks, and a rollback hook for upgrades.
description:
Motivation: Customers running Redwood Private on constrained on-prem clusters frequently use lightweight Kubernetes distributions such as k3s and RKE2. These distros have different defaults for container runtimes (containerd, crio) and simplified kubelet/systemd layouts that can break the existing online-first installer and airgap bundle. This PR produces a minimal, vendored airgap bundle targeted at k3s/rke2 and updates the installer logic to detect distro quirks and apply compatible manifests.

What this PR does (summary):
- Adds an airgap bundle variant: bundles/k3s-rke2-v1.26.tar.gz containing pre-pulled OCI image tarballs (controller, runtime, sidecars, cri-tools), curated Helm charts, and a manifest overlay directory with distro-specific tweaks.
- New helper: installer/scripts/generate-airgap-bundle.sh to build the tarball from a lockfile (images.lock) and output sha256 checksums for offline verification.
- Installer changes: installer/airgap/install.sh gained a --distro hint (k3s|rke2|generic) and automatic container runtime detection; it will load OCI tarballs into containerd and adjust systemd service overrides for k3s/rke2 where necessary.
- Helm chart patches: charts/redwood/values-airgap.yaml and small template conditionals to defer certain initContainers that assume Docker or cloud metadata.
- Terraform module tweak: terraform/modules/private_network/main.tf adds an optional nat_gateway boolean used when doing hub-and-spoke airgapped bootstrapping (helps in staging-by-proxy flows).
- Upgrade/rollback: installer/airgap/upgrade-hook.yaml adds a preflight hook that snapshots current manifests and a rollback.sh script that can be run locally to re-apply saved manifests and image states.
- Docs: docs/airgap-k3s-rke2.md with step-by-step airgapped install and verification checks.

Checklist: 
- [x] Bundle generation script + lockfile support
- [x] Container runtime loading and verification
- [x] Helm conditional compatible with k3s/rke2
- [x] Upgrade snapshot + rollback helper
- [x] Basic e2e on k3s (v1.26) and RKE2 (v1.26) clusters
- [x] Documentation and example commands

Testing performed:
- Local k3s (v1.26) lab: generated bundle, transferred to an airgapped node, ran install.sh --airgap --distro k3s. Verified all pods came up and KV cache backend connected.
- RKE2 cluster in isolated VLAN: exercised image import (ctr images import), systemd override applied for container runtime, performed an in-place upgrade of the controller and used rollback.sh to revert to previous manifest set.
- CI: installer unit tests + shellcheck + minimal integration job; initial pipeline had a transient network flake when pushing a test artifact to internal registry and was re-run manually. Final state: passing.

Backward compatibility and upgrade notes:
- Default airgap bundle is opt-in. Existing online installer behavior is unchanged unless --airgap is provided.
- The installer will fallback to "generic" mode when distro detection is ambiguous; generic behavior preserves current semantics.
- Rollback is not automatic for every failure; the preflight snapshot is required for rollback.sh to succeed. We document limitations in the new docs page.

Known limitations / follow-ups:
- We only vendor images for the minimal runtime set; some optional addons are still downloaded at install time if not present in the bundle. Plan: add an optional full-bundle in ENG-1902.
- RKE2 with CRI-O variants were tested in smoke only; additional CI coverage planned.
- We currently support k3s/rke2 for v1.26 only; future PR will expand matrix.

Context & links: Linear ENG-1847 (airgap experience), ENG-1902 (bundle sizing), support ticket SUP-322 documenting a customer incident where k3s nodes failed to load images.

Example commands (illustrative):
- Generate bundle: ./installer/scripts/generate-airgap-bundle.sh --lock images.lock --output bundles/k3s-rke2-v1.26.tar.gz
- Install in airgap: scp bundles/k3s-rke2-v1.26.tar.gz installer-node:/tmp && sudo ./installer/airgap/install.sh --bundle /tmp/k3s-rke2-v1.26.tar.gz --distro k3s
- Rollback: sudo ./installer/airgap/rollback.sh --snapshot /var/lib/redwood/snapshots/2025-11-26

Please read docs/airgap-k3s-rke2.md for full operational guidance and troubleshooting steps.
commits_summary: 5 commits: initial bundle generator (+scripts/generate-airgap-bundle.sh, +images.lock example), add k3s/rke2 overlay manifests, helm chart conditionals and values-airgap, terraform optional nat_gateway flag, docs and rollback script. Each commit is small and focused; squash-merge planned.
review_comments: Diego Ramos: Left a couple of nit comments about error messages; also suggested a more robust retry around ctr image import (handled by adding exponential backoff).
Priya Nair: Asked to document how to verify image checksum after loading; updated generate-airgap-bundle.sh to output checksums and added verification section to docs.
Ben Holloway: Approved after confirming the rollback snapshot flow on his local RKE2 cluster; noted an idea to add a dry-run --verify flag in a follow-up (ENG-1902).
Avery Cho (author): Responded to comments and pushed a follow-up commit that adds retry/backoff and checksum output. Thanks for the reviews — addressed all nits and confirmed CI green.
ci_checks: integration/airgap-smoke: pass (re-run after transient artifact push failure)
merge: Merged by Priya Nair using squash merge. Commit message summarizes bundle, installer changes, and rollback helper. Changelog entry added to docs/CHANGELOG.md.
notes: This is intentionally conservative: the bundle is targeted and small to keep customer transfer times reasonable. Operations requested we keep checksum and provenance info next to bundles for audit. We plan to follow up with an automated package signer (ENG-1975).
